column2: Seamless repeating wallpaper: bold black continuous marker linework of dancing outlined figures, barking dogs, radiant crawling babies and motion marks on matte white, Keith Haring 1986 shop mural style, dense edge to edge, flat front view, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: pale indigo and ivory woodblock print pattern of curling great waves with claw shaped foam and small boats, Japanese ukiyo-e style, fine paper grain, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: ivory with evenly spaced blue Ben-Day dots, crisp thick black architectural strokes and sparse flat red and yellow blocks, Roy Lichtenstein interior style, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: warm cream plaster with faint craquelure and small melting pocket watches and drifting ants scattered sparsely, Salvador Dali surreal style, soft desert ochre undertones, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: acid yellow paper with fluorescent pink silkscreened cow heads in rows, each cow head a pink flower with one human eye with a blue iris, slight screenprint misregistration, Andy Warhol 1966 style, flat front view, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: ivory plaster divided by hairline graphite lines into irregular cubist polygon fields in muted ochre, grey and blue, Picasso analytic cubism style, matte, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: worn cream shop plaster with scattered nail holes, pale rectangles where frames once hung, a few small black spray stencilled rats and drips, urban stencil style, flat front view, no text.

Seamless repeating wallpaper: thick impasto brush strokes in swirling cobalt blue and chrome yellow like a starry night sky, Vincent van Gogh style, visible paint ridges, flat front view, edge to edge, no text.
